{{Top|leg}}
'''Zoort''' was an individual from [[Glakka]]. When a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative, posing as a Glakka merchant, approached an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jeffren Brek]], he was asked if he knew Zoort or [[Raurlu Eloz]]. When Brek received a negative response, he was easily able to deduce that he was in fact dealing with a Rebel spy.
